run_bench_pq_transposed_centroids: run the FAISS benchmark script to compare regular vs transposed centroid search performance on BigANN-10M
test_bigann10m_index: test a FAISS index against the BigANN-10M dataset with various parameter configurations and recall metrics
unwind_index_ivf: extract an IndexIVF from a chain of FAISS transforms like IndexPreTransform or IndexRefine
benchmark_transposed_centroid_sync: benchmark the performance impact of sync_transposed_centroids on an IVF PQ index search
configure_faiss_index_parameters: configure FAISS index parameters like nprobe, quantizer_efSearch, and ht using ParameterSpace
